scope: Fifty independent evidence passes over real injection-moulding measurements. This registry stores provenance and measurement relationships only; it contains no production recipes, acceptance limits, machine-control authority, or synthetic rows presented as measured data.

passes.sourceTitle: Industrial injection/blow moulding process and quality dataset
passes.learningUse: Benchmark schema discovery, missingness, grouping and process-quality association without assuming causality.
passes.limitation: Injection and blow-moulding records must remain separated and field semantics must be verified from the publisher files.

passes.sourceTitle: Injection Molding Dataset (Viscometer, Euromap77, Quality Table)
passes.learningUse: Test whether repeated cycles and time-resolved pressure expose variation hidden by scalar settings.
passes.limitation: Only 68 experiments are described; conclusions must stay tied to this machine/material/test design.

passes.sourceTitle: Injection Molding Process Data for Post-Consumer-Recycled Materials
passes.learningUse: Compare virgin and post-consumer-recycled material under cavity-pressure and part-mass control using real time-series evidence.
passes.limitation: Controller experiments are not universal recipes and cannot establish transferability to other machines, tools or PCR grades.

passes.sourceTitle: FORinFPRO-HIMD multimodal hybrid injection-moulding sensor dataset
passes.learningUse: Study synchronized machine, pressure-temperature, ultrasound and dielectric evidence through fill, hold and cooling.
passes.limitation: Hybrid continuous-fibre polypropylene behaviour is a specialised process and should not be generalized to unfilled thermoplastics.

passes.sourceTitle: Cross-process-chain dataset archive: injection molding and screw driving
passes.learningUse: Test whether upstream moulding variation carries measurable information into downstream assembly quality.
passes.limitation: Cross-process associations are not proof of a single upstream root cause without controlled intervention evidence.

passes.sourceTitle: Online Prediction of Molded Part Quality Using High-Resolution Time Series
passes.learningUse: Prefer full high-resolution dynamics when they outperform scalar summaries for quality prediction.
passes.limitation: Prediction accuracy does not by itself identify physical causation.

passes.sourceTitle: In-cavity pressure measurements for failure diagnosis and correlation with simulation
passes.learningUse: Use curve location and timing to distinguish filling/switchover failure signatures rather than reacting to one peak value.
passes.limitation: Failure signatures remain tool/material/context dependent.

passes.sourceTitle: Quality Characterization of Micro-Injection Products Based on Cavity Pressure
passes.learningUse: Teach why pressure-time area can carry more quality information than an isolated peak.
passes.limitation: The reported correlation belongs to the tested micro-moulding setup and is not a universal acceptance rule.

passes.sourceTitle: Real-time product weight estimation based on internal pressure monitoring
passes.learningUse: Show that equal pressure integrals can correspond to different weights when the holding condition changes.
passes.limitation: A fitted saturation relation must be revalidated for each material/tool/process context.

passes.sourceTitle: Experimental effect of injection-moulding parameters on cavity pressure and product weight
passes.learningUse: Use controlled factor changes to separate process-input effects on cavity response and mass.
passes.limitation: Factor effects cannot be copied as universal production settings.

passes.sourceTitle: Injection Barrel/Nozzle/Mold-Cavity Scientific Real-Time Sensing and Quality Monitoring
passes.learningUse: Teach pressure-loss-chain reasoning and material-specific rheology monitoring across machine-to-cavity locations.
passes.limitation: Similar melt-flow index does not imply identical polymer response; exact material context matters.

passes.sourceTitle: Adaptive quality monitoring for materials with different viscosity
passes.learningUse: Separate material-viscosity evidence from clamping/load evidence and use actual sensor response rather than settings alone.
passes.limitation: Adaptive-control results do not authorize automatic changes outside the validated setup.

passes.sourceTitle: Online quality monitoring of molten resin in injection molding
passes.learningUse: Compare pressure features at multiple flow-path locations to diagnose resin/process variation.
passes.limitation: Derived indices are model features, not standalone root-cause proof.

passes.sourceTitle: Adaptive process control of the changeover point for injection molding
passes.learningUse: Use measured melt-response change to explain why a fixed transfer position may not reproduce a fixed physical state.
passes.limitation: The control law is study-specific and not a generic transfer recipe.

passes.sourceTitle: Scientific Molding and Adaptive Process Quality Control with External Sensors
passes.learningUse: Connect scientific setup order with external actual-value evidence and long-run verification.
passes.limitation: Study optimization order and control actions must not be treated as universal machine instructions.

passes.sourceTitle: Multiple In-Mold Sensors for Quality and Process Control in Injection Molding
passes.learningUse: Preserve cavity identity and compare local pressure behaviour before averaging multicavity data.
passes.limitation: Sensor locations and cavity geometry influence feature meaning.

passes.sourceTitle: Integrated Capacitance-Pressure-Temperature Sensing Probe for Injection Molding Monitoring
passes.learningUse: Add material-state sensing to pressure/temperature and test whether dielectric response improves quality interpretation.
passes.limitation: Capacitance response depends on material and sensor geometry and requires calibration.

passes.sourceTitle: Integrated capacitance-pressure-temperature sensor for shrinkage estimation and leakage detection
passes.learningUse: Treat abnormal cross-sensor relationships as evidence of a changed physical state rather than trusting one channel.
passes.limitation: An anomaly signature does not identify a universal maintenance threshold.

passes.sourceTitle: Adaptive transfer learning with C-P-T sensor fusion for few-shot anomaly diagnosis
passes.learningUse: Study which sensor relationships survive machine/material transfer and which require re-learning.
passes.limitation: Classification performance is not a substitute for engineering verification of the physical cause.

passes.sourceTitle: On-line measurement of cavity pressure via ultrasonic investigation of tie bar
passes.learningUse: Teach indirect pressure sensing and the need to calibrate structural proxies against independent measurements.
passes.limitation: Tie-bar/clamp configuration affects calibration; indirect pressure must not be assumed transferable.

passes.sourceTitle: Machine Learning in Injection Molding: An Industry 4.0 Method of Quality Prediction
passes.learningUse: Use pressure-derived features for classification while retaining cavity identity and uncertainty.
passes.limitation: High classification accuracy does not make the model a causal diagnostic authority.

passes.sourceTitle: Quality Classification of Injection-Molded Components by Quality Indices, Grading, and Machine Learning
passes.learningUse: Preserve an explicit uncertain/to-be-confirmed region instead of forcing every observation into pass/fail.
passes.limitation: Model grades depend on the study's measurement and quality definitions.

passes.sourceTitle: Novel Analysis Methodology of Cavity Pressure Profiles Using Interpretation of Machine Learning Model
passes.learningUse: Link model-important pressure regions back to physical phases rather than treating ML as a black box.
passes.limitation: Feature importance is associative and requires physical confirmation.

passes.sourceTitle: Data-driven quality prediction in injection molding: autoencoder and machine-learning approach
passes.learningUse: Retain full curve information when compact learned representations improve prediction over hand-picked scalar features.
passes.limitation: Latent features need interpretation before they can support mechanism-level education.

passes.sourceTitle: Monitoring and dynamic control of quality stability for injection molding process
passes.learningUse: Separate monitoring/prediction from intervention and require before/after quality verification.
passes.limitation: Closed-loop study control logic is not a generic production-control recommendation.

passes.sourceTitle: Self-optimizing local mold temperature control for inline warpage reduction
passes.learningUse: Treat local thermal imbalance as spatial evidence and verify geometry response after temperature correction.
passes.limitation: The segmented thermal system is specialised and its controller values are not transferable.

passes.sourceTitle: Relationship between Warpage and Temperature Distribution in a Mold
passes.learningUse: Use opposing-side/local temperature differences as direct evidence for thermal warpage mechanisms.
passes.limitation: Magnitude depends on geometry, material, channel layout and measurement method.

passes.sourceTitle: Experimental and Numerical Study Determining Warpage of Thin-Wall Injection Molding
passes.learningUse: Compare measured geometry with simulated trends and keep physical measurement as the verification layer.
passes.limitation: Optimization outcomes belong to the tested thin-wall part and factor ranges.

passes.sourceTitle: Filling-To-Packing Switchover Mode Based on Cavity Temperature
passes.learningUse: Show that a thermal state variable can discriminate process state differently from time/position-only transfer.
passes.limitation: Sensor position and material/tool conditions determine whether the method transfers.

passes.sourceTitle: In-Mold Monitoring of Temperature and Cavity Pressure During Injection Molding
passes.learningUse: Compare flow-path pressure/temperature measurements with simulation and use disagreement as evidence, not nuisance.
passes.limitation: Spiral-flow geometry is a characterization tool, not a direct production recipe.

passes.sourceTitle: In process quality control on micro-injection moulding: role of sensor location
passes.learningUse: Teach that sensor location changes what is observed and that runner evidence can sometimes discriminate micro-feature quality.
passes.limitation: Micro-feature replication results are highly geometry- and polymer-specific.

passes.sourceTitle: Replication integrity using variotherm and vacuum-assisted microinjection moulding
passes.learningUse: Separate thermal and air-management mechanisms by combining pressure, interface temperature and replication measurements.
passes.limitation: Variotherm/vacuum equipment changes the process boundary and should not be generalized to conventional tools.

passes.sourceTitle: Effects of Cavity Thickness on Replication of Micro Injection Molded Parts
passes.learningUse: Include geometry/cavity thickness as an explanatory variable rather than attributing replication only to machine settings.
passes.limitation: Replication metrics are specific to the tested microstructure array.

passes.sourceTitle: Investigation of micro-injection moulding: factors affecting replication quality
passes.learningUse: Teach factor interactions and that increasing a factor can improve fill yet worsen another surface-quality response.
passes.limitation: Observed factor direction can change with material and geometry.

passes.sourceTitle: Effect of a pressurized cavity on replication of micro-patterns in injection molding
passes.learningUse: Treat cavity gas/air state as a measurable boundary condition affecting flow-front behaviour and replication.
passes.limitation: Pressurized-cavity experiments are not equivalent to ordinary production venting conditions.

passes.sourceTitle: In process monitoring of polymer batch to batch variation in injection moulding
passes.learningUse: Preserve lot identity and use in-process rheology evidence to detect differences that supplier checks may miss.
passes.limitation: No single viscosity-index-to-quality relationship should be assumed across materials.

passes.sourceTitle: Dynamic Monitoring Based on Operating Condition Drift Detection and Incremental Learning
passes.learningUse: Represent material, machine, auxiliary and setting drift as different evidence families before retraining a quality model.
passes.limitation: Incremental-learning performance is not proof that a detected drift has one physical cause.

passes.sourceTitle: Warpage Mechanism due to Fiber Orientation during Injection Molding
passes.learningUse: Link anisotropic orientation measurements to directional warpage rather than treating filled polymers as isotropic.
passes.limitation: Orientation/warpage relationships depend on gate, geometry, fibre system and processing history.

passes.sourceTitle: Fiber orientation in simple injection moldings. Part II: Experimental results
passes.learningUse: Use measured orientation fields as evidence for flow-history and anisotropy models.
passes.limitation: Simple test geometries do not establish orientation fields for arbitrary production components.

passes.sourceTitle: Influence of processing, melt flow rate and reinforcement on polypropylene weld-line characteristics
passes.learningUse: Separate material-grade and reinforcement effects from limited process compensation at weld lines.
passes.limitation: Mechanical outcomes are product/material specific and cannot become generic quality limits.

passes.sourceTitle: Study of Effects of Injection Molding Parameters on Weld Line Formation
passes.learningUse: Treat weld-line geometry as a measured outcome tied to material and tool design, not only a cosmetic label.
passes.limitation: Simulation agreement varies with condition and does not replace measurement.

passes.sourceTitle: External Gas-Assisted Mold Temperature Control Improves Weld Line Quality
passes.learningUse: Link local thermal intervention to measured weld-line outcome with before/after verification.
passes.limitation: Special heating hardware and tested geometry define the applicable boundary.

passes.sourceTitle: Effects of obstacle geometry and injection parameters on weld-line strength
passes.learningUse: Keep geometry as a causal candidate when mechanical weld-line strength changes under similar processing.
passes.limitation: Strength results belong to the tested polypropylene specimen and weld geometry.

passes.sourceTitle: Analysis of Weld Lines in Micro-Injection Molding
passes.learningUse: Treat weld-line position and local feature scale as evidence when diagnosing micro-part mechanical weakness.
passes.limitation: Micro-scale weld behaviour should not be extrapolated directly to conventional part geometries.

passes.sourceTitle: Injection-molded plastic parts defect dataset: images, masks and quantitative defect metrics
passes.learningUse: Prepare a future benchmark linking process configuration to quantified multi-defect vision outcomes while preserving part/cavity identity.
passes.limitation: Files are embargoed; metadata may be registered but no raw-data validation can be claimed before access is lawful.

passes.sourceTitle: Energy monitoring of plastic injection molding on hydraulic machines
passes.learningUse: Separate base/machine energy from throughput/cycle effects using measured per-cycle profiles.
passes.limitation: Energy signatures are machine- and process-specific and are not universal maintenance thresholds.

passes.sourceTitle: Electricity Consumption Estimation of Polymer Injection-Molding: Empirical Model and Application
passes.learningUse: Teach machine-selection and part/process context as explanatory variables for energy, not just a single kWh-per-shot benchmark.
passes.limitation: Empirical estimation requires validation before use on a different machine fleet.

passes.sourceTitle: Characterizing Energy Consumption of the Injection Molding Process
passes.learningUse: Use energy accounting as a process/resource characterization layer rather than a quality-control proxy by itself.
passes.limitation: Energy models do not establish part-quality causation without linked quality measurements.

passes.sourceTitle: Injection-moulding predictive-maintenance case using electrical and vibration condition monitoring
passes.learningUse: Keep condition-monitoring spectra/trends separate from moulding-quality signals while testing whether maintenance events explain process drift.
passes.limitation: Condition indicators require machine-specific baselines and maintenance confirmation.

passes.sourceTitle: Injection-Molded Polypropylene Parts: Experimental Process Dataset with Part Weights, Energy Consumption and CAD Geometry
passes.learningUse: Prepare a future joint robustness/energy/weight benchmark with repeated part measurements and geometric provenance.
passes.limitation: Files are embargoed; MouldMaster must not claim a measured benchmark run until the publisher files are actually accessible and fingerprinted.
